text: The Jockey Club of Saudi Arabia was established in 1965 and 'is tasked with the organisation, development and promotion of Saudi Arabian horseracing at domestic and international level'; its history page records that a Royal Decree from King Faisal Bin Abdulaziz entrusted the presidency to Prince Abdullah Bin Abdulaziz.
short: JCSA established 1965 under a royal decree
